Il Problema dei dati in strutture non st: The problem of data in non-standard structures
Nel panorama aziendale moderno, le azien: In the modern business landscape, companies produce an enormous amount of data daily. However, this data is often in non-standard formats or structures
impedendo la creazione di valore attrave: preventing the creation of value through inter-company collaboration.
Il Data model mapper nasce per superare: The Data model mapper was born to overcome this limitation, allowing users to map and transform data into a format
Il Data model mapper supporta il modello: The Data model mapper supports the data model
un formato standard aperto che consente: an open standard format that allows the semantic representation of data. This model is designed to be flexible and scalable, facilitating the integration and sharing of data between different platforms and applications.
Come Funziona il Data model mapper: How the Data model mapper works
Il Data model mapper consente agli utent: The Data model mapper allows users to define mapping rules between their data and the (possibly) NGSI model. Through an intuitive interface, users can select the entities and attributes to map, define the necessary transformations, and generate the output. Supported input formats include JSON, GEOJSON, CSV, making the data integration process simple and fast. Output formats can be JSON and GEOJSON. Inputs can come from its internal DB, a local file, an external URL, or Minio. The output can be downloaded or sent to Orion. The Data model mapper supports 3 operating modes:
gli utenti possono caricare i loro dati: users can upload their data through a UI and map entities and attributes interactively.
gli utenti possono utilizzare NodeJS per: users can use NodeJS to invoke a javascript mapping script through the command prompt
il Data model mapper offre un'API RESTfu: the Data model mapper offers a RESTful API for the data mapping process, which the web app relies on
Tutte e 3 le modalità condividono il med: All 3 modes share the same functionality
tutti i dati e i passaggi possono essere: all data and steps can be saved on
la modalità UI genera automaticamente un: the UI mode automatically generates a
per l’API, facilitando integrazione e au: for the API, facilitating integration and automation.
File utente, URL, DB interno, Minio: User file, URL, internal DB, Minio
Parametri che influenzano mappatura e fl: Parameters that influence mapping and data flow
Definisce la struttura dell'output: Defines the structure of the output
Relazione tra proprietà di input e outpu: Relationship between input and output properties
Input da Minio per integrarlo con altri: Input from Minio to integrate it with other services and share mapping files.
Possibilità di utilizzare i dati già pre: Possibility to use the data already present in the internal DB for mapping.
Salva dati di input direttamente nel DB: Save input data directly in the DB to reuse it later
Possibilità di invocare il processo di m: Possibility to invoke the mapping process via RESTful API for automatic integration.
Uso rapido del Data model mapper tramite: Quick use of the Data model mapper via NodeJS to run mapping scripts directly from the terminal.
Interfaccia intuitiva per caricare file,: Intuitive interface to upload files, define mappings and download results in a few clicks.
Wizard per guidare l'utente passo passo: Wizard to guide the user step by step
Possibilità di inviare direttamente i da: Possibility to directly send mapped data to Orion for immediate and secure sharing.
Esplora come trasformare i tuoi dati in: Explore how to transform your data in a simple and fast way.
Un' azienda sviluppa software e necessit: A company develops software and needs configuration files for its products but during development the configuration files change continuously and it needs a way to migrate the data in an automated way without having to rewrite everything.

Different companies working in the same sector could set up their data differently and need a way to share the data without having to rewrite everything.
